subject: Bridge-window rotation proposal to avoid APAC Golden Week & Diwali clashes
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Hiroshi Tanaka <hiroshi.tanaka@kawasaki-tech.jp>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudwave.io>, Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@edenbilling.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge-window rotation proposal to avoid APAC Golden Week & Diwali clashes

Hi everyone —

We recently noticed a couple of scheduling risks for the demo series we have planned with CloudWave / Kawasaki Tech / Eden Billing:

- Japan Golden Week (early May) will affect availability for several APAC attendees. Kawasaki flagged May 3–5 as company holidays.
- Diwali (early November) typically creates wide OOO coverage across India teams.
- European daylight saving differences also shift workable overlap windows by an hour in late March.

To reduce friction and give predictable coverage for engineering + product-focused demos, I propose we adopt a rotating "bridge-window" pattern for customer-facing demos over the next two quarters:

Option A (two-session split, recommended):
  • APAC-friendly session (08:00–10:00 JST / 00:00–02:00 GMT) — earlier for APAC mornings, late for EU/US watchers on recording.
  • EU/US session (16:00–18:00 BST / 11:00–13:00 PDT) — tailors to EU afternoon + US mornings.

Option B (single sliding window): rotate the single demo start time week-by-week so that each region gets at least one session at an ideal local hour every three weeks.

I've attached an availability .ics with candidate slots and a short PDF that maps holidays and DST edges against our proposed rotation. Please review and reply with constraints or a preferred option. If stakeholders prefer a single date per account (one session), we should lock dates before April to avoid Golden Week conflicts.

Next steps:
- Hiroshi / Sanjay / Emma: call out any absolute blackout dates for your teams.
- Neha / Lauren / Aditya: confirm whether we can staff both sessions (PM + Eng) or need to stagger product/infra presence.

Thanks — aiming to finalize by EOD Friday so calendar invites go out before PTO season.

Best,
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: updated-candidate-timeslots.ics, demo-rotation-plan.pdf
From: Hiroshi Tanaka <hiroshi.tanaka@kawasaki-tech.jp>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:26:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Bridge-window rotation proposal to avoid APAC Golden Week & Diwali clashes

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the clear plan. A couple of notes from our side:

1) Kawasaki Tech will be broadly OOO for Golden Week — May 1–6 (we have staggered local teams but engineering leads are out May 3–5). That makes any session inside May 3–5 difficult.
2) We prefer Option A if we can get an APAC morning that still has a second (recorded) session for EU/US. Our product team would like live Q&A, so having both is ideal.

If you want us to guarantee a live attendee, earlier April dates are better for us (April 12–23) or post-May 10. If you choose rotating single windows, could you avoid May 3–6 in the rotation rules?

—Hiroshi
Senior PM, Platform Integrations
Kawasaki Tech

Hi Mateo —

Appreciate the heads-up. A note on Diwali timing: our engineering org historically has heavy PTO around the festival (Nov 3–6 in 2027 are likely to be impacted for many of our India-based squads). If you are planning quarter-ahead scheduling, we should mark early November as a low-coverage window.

For near-term demos (Q2), Option A works for CloudWave too — we can commit 1 dedicated engineer for the APAC-friendly session and a separate product lead for the EU/US session. We also prefer locking those April slots if Kawasaki can do them.

Sanjay Patel
Head of Solutions, CloudWave
sanjay.patel@cloudwave.io
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:15:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Bridge-window rotation proposal to avoid APAC Golden Week & Diwali clashes

Thanks — consolidated update from ops/coverage:

- Staffing: we can staff two sessions on the same day if we split responsibilities: Eng coverage for APAC session (Mateo + engineer), Product + Solutions for EU/US session (Lauren + Neha). Aditya noted he can rotate as backup.
- Calendar/DST: late March DST shifts will move the EU window an hour earlier; I've updated the attached PDF to show the DST edge (see demo-rotation-plan.pdf).
- Action: propose we lock two demo dates to test the rotation in April (ideal window Apr 14 and Apr 21). Both dates avoid Kawasaki Golden Week and are well before the EU DST change fully propagates.

I attached an .ics with both candidate invites. If external teams confirm by EOD Monday, we'll send outbound calendar invites with explicit local-time labels and 'recording + condensed Q&A' for those who can't attend live.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Bridge-window rotation proposal to avoid APAC Golden Week & Diwali clashes

Perfect — thank you all for the quick responses.

Plan we will execute:
1) Lock two pilot demo dates: Apr 14 (APAC-friendly morning + EU/US recorded session) and Apr 21 (repeat to capture any missed attendees).
2) Send invites with clear local-time labels and a single Zoom with two start times listed; recordings made available within 24 hours.
3) Mark May 3–6 as blackout in the rotation rules to avoid Golden Week. Mark Nov 3–6 as low coverage for Diwali in our yearly scheduler.
4) Ops will post a short runbook (roles for each session) and Aditya will be backup for escalations.

I'll go ahead and publish the invites after Neha uploads the finalized .ics to the shared Drive link. If anyone needs different staffing, speak up before EOD Friday.

—Mateo
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
